commitflow.command.showLineCommit: Show Commit Details for Current Line
commitflow.command.showPersonalStats: Show My Personal Impact & Branch Stats
commitflow.config.title: CommitFlow
commitflow.config.inlineBlame.enabled: Show author and commit information at the end of the current active line.
commitflow.config.inlineBlame.delay: Debounce delay (ms) before computing inline blame after cursor movement.
commitflow.config.avatars.enabled: Enable author profile picture and avatar resolution in hover and graph cards.
commitflow.config.avatars.service: Avatar provider to resolve author profile pictures by email.
commitflow.config.graph.pageSize: Maximum number of commits loaded per page in the graph view.
commitflow.config.graph.density: Row height and density of the commit graph table (compact, comfortable, spacious).
commitflow.config.graph.theme: Color theme for CommitFlow: auto (match VS Code), dark, or light.
commitflow.config.graph.layoutMode: Layout orientation of CommitFlow (auto, bottom, left, right).
commitflow.config.graph.animations: Enable smooth motion choreography, pulse dots, and micro-interactions in the graph.
commitflow.config.language: Language for CommitFlow interface (auto, es, en).
commitflow.config.sync.autoFetch: Periodically poll remote repository changes in background.
commitflow.config.sync.fetchIntervalMinu: Auto-fetch interval in minutes (0 to disable).
commitflow.config.sync.notifyOnBranchMer: Notify when a branch is merged or remote has new commits and ask before pull.
commitflow.config.sync.askBeforePull: Show confirmation dialog before executing git pull.
